body: Nano Banana is Google's image generation family. On KeyoAPI all three tiers run on the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint: POST /v1/images/generations with model=nano-banana-2.1 (newer release, $0.0123 per image), model=nano-banana-2 (base lane, $0.0205) or model=nano-banana-pro (top tier with higher resolution and finer editing control, $0.0274). Use each model’s documented aspect-ratio and imageSize limits.

Billing is per generated image. A request can return a result immediately or HTTP 202 with a continuing task; save task_id and query GET /v1/images/tasks/{task_id} with the same API key. Keyo rates above are indicative sell prices from the live Keyo catalog; confirm the interactive card under /pricing before volume, and treat official Google figures as planning context — list bands move.

Per-tier walkthroughs live on the model guides: /model/nano-banana-2.1, /model/nano-banana-2 and /model/nano-banana-pro. For other image lanes on the same key (gpt-image and friends) see /pricing-list.

Use aspectRatio (for example 1:1) and imageSize (1K, 2K or 4K); do not send GPT-style pixel sizes. Keep the returned task_id: HTTP 202 means the same task is still running. Query GET /v1/images/tasks/{task_id} with the same API key until HTTP 200, status=succeeded and data[].url is nonempty. See /brand/keyo-api-ref.html#section-3 for reference images, idempotency and error recovery.

faqs.q: Which Nano Banana tier should I use?
faqs.a: Start with nano-banana-2.1 — the newer release at the lowest per-image rate ($0.0123). Keep nano-banana-2 where your stack pins the base lane ($0.0205), and escalate to nano-banana-pro ($0.0274) when you need higher resolution and finer editing control for commercial work.

faqs.q: How is Nano Banana billed on KeyoAPI?
faqs.a: Per generated image, at the tier's rate. The images endpoint may return HTTP 202 while processing. Save task_id and poll GET /v1/images/tasks/{task_id}; do not resubmit a new generation.

faqs.q: How do I try Nano Banana on Keyo?
faqs.a: Create a key at /sign-up and open /pricing (Model Square) to find the nano-banana tiers, or start with a gift-credit ID on /free-models to wire your client first.
